CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS curated_sales ( order_id string, customer_id string, product_id string, product_name string, category string, country string, quantity int, price double, order_total decimal(12,2), status string, order_date timestamp ) PARTITIONED BY (year string, month string, day string) STORED AS PARQUET LOCATION 's3://de-training-749185461065/curated/sales/'
SELECT rejection_reason, COUNT(*) AS rows_rejected FROM quarantine_sales GROUP BY rejection_reason ORDER BY rows_rejected DESC
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS sales_by_category_ctas
MSCK REPAIR TABLE curated_sales

SELECT country, customer_id, revenue, rnk FROM ( SELECT country, customer_id, SUM(order_total) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY SUM(order_total) DESC) AS rnk FROM curated_sales GROUP BY country, customer_id ) WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY country, rnk

CREATE TABLE sales_by_category_ctas WITH ( format = 'PARQUET', write_compression = 'SNAPPY' ) AS SELECT category, country, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(order_total) AS revenue FROM curated_sales GROUP BY category, country
